svg.title: 答案是经约束后显影的 PATH / An Answer Is a PATH That Survives to Expression
svg.desc: 候选结构在动态约束下形成不同结果，包括消散、保留和合格显影。 Candidate structures may dissipate, persist, or qualify for expression under evolving constraints.
